rationale: DH-02 6H survived Phase 1 on Binance Spot 2021-2022 and independently validated on Binance Spot 2019-2020. Phase 3 tests the same frozen Donchian sibling family on a materially different Binance market, USD-M perpetual futures, without selecting a single winning timeframe and without opening 2023-2026.
scope: Structural price-path validation only. Funding cashflows are not included because bar-level stop/target execution does not identify a unique intrabar exit timestamp relative to funding events. Therefore a Phase 3 survivor is not a funding-adjusted perpetual trading PnL claim and does not authorize live trading.

dataset.listing_aware_policy: Monthly archives absent before a symbol's first official available USD-M archive are PRE_LISTING_UNAVAILABLE and not filled. After first availability, any later missing month inside 2020-2022 is SOURCE_GAP_BLOCKED. No alternate provider, synthetic fill, interpolation or spot backfill.
dataset.canonicalization: Only complete consecutive 1m rows form UTC-aligned 15m bars. Incomplete buckets dropped. Higher-timeframe continuity split across gaps.

costs.note: Same conservative synthetic transaction-cost model as Spot validation; funding excluded and separately caveated.

family_policy: Both 6H and 12H are always reported. No post-outcome winner selection. Cross-market survival is additional structural evidence only and is not equivalent to funding-adjusted execution validation.
